Subject Line: Exterior Modification Application - Roof Replacement

Dear Centerpointe Community Association Architectural Review Board,

Greetings!

This email serves as my request for approval of an exterior modification to my property. The proposed modification involves replacing the flat roof of my residence with a new TPO (thermoplastic polyolefin) roofing system.

Description of Proposed Modification:
All Day Roofing & More LLC (3060 Williams Dr, Suite 300 #505, Fairfax, VA 22031, Phone: 703-627-0771, Company Representative: Daniel Nannucci, dnannucci@alldayroofingandmore.com) will be carrying out the roof replacement work.

The scope of work includes:
1. Removal of the existing flat roof
2. Installation of a new 60mil TPO flat roof replacement system covering 8 squares (sq) of roof area
3. Installation of 24 pieces of slope board insulation as part of a tapered system
4. Installation of 1 roll of flashing, 10 drip edges, and 4 finish bars
5. Application of 10 gallons of glue, 1 gallon of primer, and 100 linear feet of cover tape
6. Use of 1000 insulation plates and 1000 insulation screws

The total cost for this Option 1 - TPO 60mil (15-20 year warranty) is $12,800.

The contractor expects to complete the work within 7-10 days after receiving the required 50% deposit, subject to favorable weather conditions.

Please let me know if you need any additional information or documentation to process this application.

Thank you for your consideration.

Best regards,
[Your name]

Subject: HOA Exterior Modification Application - Roof Repairs

Dear HOA Architectural Review Board,

Greetings. I am submitting this application for the following exterior home modification:

Description of Proposed Modification:
The proposed work is a roof repair performed by American Home Contractors (AHC), a licensed roofing contractor. Their contractor license numbers are:

- Maryland Home Improvement Commission (MHIC) #31337-03  
- Virginia Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation (DPOR) #2705190396

The scope of work includes:

1. Repairing damaged areas of the existing EPDM (rubber) roof and metal flashing/apron by installing new flexible flashing (KarleFlex) and sealant patches over the affected areas. 
2. Cleaning the roof surface and properly preparing it for patching.
3. Patching any holes or potential leaks, sealing the seams, and matching the existing black roof color on the EPDM sections.
4. Matching the existing almond color on the metal apron flashing areas.

All work will be performed using high-quality roofing materials from reputable manufacturers.

The total cost for this roof repair project is $2,850.00 as per AHC's estimate dated May 12, 2026.

The anticipated timeline is 1-2 days for completion once the project commences, subject to weather conditions. AHC can be contacted at info@amhomeco.com or (301) 209-7000 for any additional details.

Please let me know if any other information is required for this application.

Best regards,
[Your name]
